description: Source code for string buffer routines (strbuf), including memory management, resizing, appending, and formatting functions.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by printing a message and exiting.

methods.name: strbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes a string buffer with a specified length.

methods.name: strbuf_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new string buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_set_increment
methods.description: Sets the buffer growth increment, either linear or exponential.

methods.name: debug_stats
methods.description: Prints debug information about the string buffer if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: strbuf_free
methods.description: Frees the string buffer and its internal buffer if dynamically allocated.

methods.name: strbuf_free_to_string
methods.description: Returns the internal buffer as a string and optionally its length.

methods.name: calculate_new_size
methods.description: Calculates new buffer size based on requested length and growth strategy.

methods.name: strbuf_resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to accommodate a specified string length.

methods.name: strbuf_append_string
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_append_fmt
methods.description: Appends formatted data to the buffer with a known upper bound.

methods.name: strbuf_append_fmt_retry
methods.description: Appends formatted data to the buffer, resizing if necessary when length is unknown.
